title: Tilings and Symmetry
summary: Which shapes fit together with no gaps, line and rotational symmetry, and patterns in art and nature.

ib.note: Tessellations and symmetry are MYP 2 Geometry

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 6: Constructions and Tilings

objectives: I can explain why some regular polygons tile the plane.
I can find combinations of polygons that meet at a point.
I can identify line and rotational symmetry.
misconceptions: All regular polygons can tile a floor.
Rotational symmetry and line symmetry are the same.
A shape with no lines of symmetry has no symmetry at all.
